claims.claim_text: John Dobo has a high-confidence identity crosswalk to the official Army bulk file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed name and a nonshared protected identifier agree with official Army bulk ordinal 4127916.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Name and protected identifier agree; the identifier is not shared by another indexed person in the crosswalk.
claims.temporal_assessment: Army identity only; neither source establishes a pre-OSS employer or the last military assignment before OSS.
claims.match_notes: Do not publish the full identifier or interpret the Army civilian-occupation code as a named employer. Keep John separate from Francis Dobo.

sources.locator_override: Official bulk ordinal 4127916; protected comparison held privately

person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 189 for Theodore D'Luski's identity, directly prior OSS assignment, and named civilian employer; do not equate an unbridged Ted Dluski with this indexed person.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The rendered index prints 'Dobberstein, J' in the surname cell and 'Albert' in the given-name cell. Whether J belongs to a forename, middle initial, or another notation is unresolved; no normalized correction is asserted.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 190 to resolve the printed Dobberstein, J / Albert column split before changing display order or attaching namesake employment.
Inspect Box 190 for Paul Dobbs's identifying details and a dated pre-OSS employer or military predecessor; printed serial formatting was visually checked but is not published.
Inspect Box 190 to distinguish John F Dobes from John Dobes Jr roster namesakes and establish prior employment or assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: A same-name wartime career lead lacks a Box 190 or protected-identifier bridge. Its employment history is withheld pending file review.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 190 for a full name, service identifiers, and documented wartime chronology before assigning any candidate employer history.

person_updates.identity_evidence: Indexed John Dobo and official Army bulk ordinal 4127916 share a nonshared protected identifier and concordant name. The Army record does not establish a named employer or OSS transfer date.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 190 for John Dobo's last civilian employer and immediately preceding military assignment; keep separate from Francis Dobo.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA page 119 row 41; CIA and LoC checks; Theodore D'Luski/Dluski OSS, Ted Dluski, 1940 occupation/employer, obituary, institutional and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: An unsourced same-name genealogy entry and a military-newsletter Ted Dluski lack an OSS/Box 189 identity bridge and do not establish a named pre-OSS employer.
research_attempts.next_action: Inspect Box 189 for identity and prior work.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA page 119 row 42; CIA and LoC checks; printed Dobberstein, J / Albert, J Albert and Albert J search aliases, T-5, 1940 employer/occupation, directory and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A postwar Nebraska directory names an Albert Dobberstein without an OSS/Box 190 bridge. The letter J remains in the printed surname cell; no surname or forename correction is supported.
research_attempts.next_action: Inspect Box 190 and preserve the printed column split.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA page 119 row 43; CIA and LoC checks; Paul Dobbs OSS, 1940 occupation/employer, obituary, institutional, newspaper and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Accessible results did not provide a corroborated wartime identity or named date-bounded pre-OSS employer; no common-name biography was adopted.
research_attempts.next_action: Inspect Box 190 for identity and predecessor affiliation.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA page 119 row 44; CIA and LoC checks; John F Dobes OSS, John Dobes Jr roster, 1940 occupation/employer, obituary and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A World War II roster names John Dobes Jr without middle initial or protected OSS identifier; it cannot establish that he is the indexed John F Dobes or identify a predecessor employer.
research_attempts.next_action: Inspect Box 190 for identity and prior work.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA page 119 row 45; CIA and LoC checks; Francis Dobo, Francis F Dobo, Ferenc Dobo, OSS/OWI, Opera Mundi, Gabriel Wells, 1940 occupation/employer, institutional and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A family-history interview documents Francis F. Dobo's Opera Mundi, Gabriel Wells, and OWI chronology but does not link him to the Box 190 OSS index row; British Library and Tate archival descriptions concern postwar activity. No employer is assigned to the indexed person.
research_attempts.research_notes: Private identity lead: https://punkt.hu/en/2024/06/30/a-previously-unknown-hungarian-related-photo-collection-discovered-in-america-interview-with-michael-dobo/ . Do not copy family details, photographs, or postwar jobs into the public profile.
research_attempts.next_action: Inspect Box 190 for full name and OSS/OWI service chronology; compare against Francis F. Dobo only with direct identifiers.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA page 119 row 46; CIA and LoC checks; John Dobo OSS, 1940 occupation/employer, obituary, institutional and archival searches; official Army bulk ordinal 4127916.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Official Army bulk establishes identity but its civilian-occupation code is not a named employer. Later John Dobo obituaries lack a wartime identity bridge and do not establish pre-OSS work.
research_attempts.next_action: Inspect Box 190 for an employer and immediate prior unit.
